Dear [Mr Furnivall](/person/531)
I am afraid I cannot now read the books mentioned, as they have drifted out of my reach and I have much less time than I had in the old times when it was undertaken[^1]

Yours truly
C.M. Yonge


[^1]: CMY and her mother had been recruited by Furnivall among the readers collecting quotations for the [project](/topic/151) which was to become the New English Dictionary.
